name: Fouquet's Paris
positioning: Hotel on the Champs-Élysées at 46 Avenue George V, built around Brasserie Fouquet's (open since 1899), with Jacques Garcia interiors, a rooftop bar and a 750-square-meter spa
best_for: Travelers who want a Champs-Élysées base with a historic Paris brasserie under the same roof
Guests who want a spa with a heated indoor pool in central Paris

facts.text: The hotel is on the Champs-Élysées.
The hotel's address is 46 Avenue George V, 75008 Paris.
The hotel's interiors were designed by Jacques Garcia.
The decor uses velvet, mahogany and crystal, with baroque salons.
Rooms feature marble bathrooms and tones of beige and gold.
Joy restaurant has an inner garden and alcoves bordered by a large library, and serves contemporary and refined cuisine.
The spa covers 750 square meters, with a sauna, hammam, ice room and ice wall.
The spa blends French elegance with Japanese beauty expertise.
Room service is available 24 hours a day.
Valet parking is complimentary for all guests.
Cribs are available on request at no extra charge.
The hotel offers an experience to explore Paris on a private boat.

highlights.text: Brasserie Fouquet's, inside the hotel, has been open since 1899.
The Rooftop cocktail bar is on the hotel's 5th floor.
L'Escadrille bar was once a meeting place for aviators and serves classic mixology.
The Harcourt Paris Suite has a private terrace and a photo studio.
The spa has a 15-meter heated indoor swimming pool.

considerations.text: The hotel is in the busy Golden Triangle; the hotel describes Joy restaurant as a retreat from that bustle.
Pets are welcome, but only subject to specific conditions.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing and a busy tourist location on the Champs-Élysées.
